content:
incident-bot: [P2] Metering anomaly detected — shadow-agg reported sustained token-count drift vs. realtime emitter. Triggered 2025-11-03T14:32:56Z. Affected: EU region, small-to-mid customers. Auto-escalate to oncall. @oncall-alice @ben-billing <https://internal/reports/ghost-count-20251103>
oncall-alice: taking this. ping if you need me to page more people. starting quick triage.
oncall-alice: looking at aggregator offsets now. seeing +12-18% delta across several windows.
ben-billing: heads up: 3 customers already got overage emails from the notification service within last hour. I'm pausing outbound billing notifications until we know scope. :no_entry_sign:
carol-sre: any deploys/rollouts in metering in the last 6h? I see a small emitter optimization rolled at 08:40 UTC earlier.
oncall-alice: yep saw that: emitter v2.1.4 pushed to EU. Rolling logs show increased duplicate ack counts.
carol-sre: suspect emitter duplicate emission path. quick check: tail the emitter logs and the agg ingestion path.
carol-sre: command I ran:
```
kubectl -n metering logs deploy/emitter -c app --since=30m | grep "emit=" | head -n 50
kubectl -n metering logs deploy/shadow-agg -c ingest --since=30m | grep "offset_delta"
```
oncall-alice: logs show sequences re-emitted on transient 503 to proxy. sample:
```
2025-11-03T14:20:12Z emitter INFO emit=id=abcd123 seq=1001 retry=true
2025-11-03T14:20:13Z emitter WARN upstream=proxy-1 status=503
2025-11-03T14:20:13Z emitter INFO emit=id=abcd123 seq=1001 retry=true
```
ben-billing: that would double-count unless dedupe happens downstream. shadow-agg supposed to dedupe by event id but looks like event id schema changed in v2.1.4.
dave-support: customers flagged: acct: acme-corp, beta-inc, smallstart. Tickets created: ZK-4521 ZK-4522 ZK-4523. They've asked if charges are accurate.
ben-billing: immediate mitigation: pause billing notifications (done). Considering temporary billing hold (suspend invoice calc) for affected accounts while we confirm. Thoughts?
carol-sre: mitigation plan:
- short term: toggle emitter retry->disabled for EU (flip feature flag) to stop re-emits
- run dedupe backfill for last 2h to compute correct counts
- if dedupe backfill < threshold, roll forward; else, apply temporary hold and refund/adjust
I'll open the deploy rollback runbook if needed.
oncall-alice: on it. toggling flag now.
carol-sre: command: `curl -X POST https://ff.internal/api/toggle -d '{"feature":"emitter-retry","region":"eu","value":false}'` (rolled back at 14:46 UTC)
oncall-alice: emitter retry flag disabled at 2025-11-03T14:46:10Z. Traffic in EU shows single emits now.
carol-sre: starting dedupe job against shadow-agg snapshot (range last 2h). estimated run 10-15m.
ben-billing: good. I'll hold invoicing for the 3 affected accounts and mark them as investigating. Also reaching out to comms for potential customer note.
dave-support: replied to acme-corp: "We're investigating inconsistent usage display; temporary billing notifications paused. We'll follow up within 4 hours." Customer replied :thumbsup:
oncall-alice: dedupe job progress: 40% complete; early results: ~13% of tokens were duplicates for sample window; matches delta.
carol-sre: looks like root cause is a change in event id generation in v2.1.4 that removed a stable shard id field. Patch: revert emitter id format change and release v2.1.5 with original id schema.
carol-sre: risk assessment: if we don't fix, more customers will get false overages as queues retry. We should schedule a hotfix release after dedupe completes.
ben-billing: agree. create INC ticket and link to customer tickets. I'll prepare a temporary credit policy for impacted customers.
oncall-alice: dedupe job finished 15:01 UTC. final corrections: 12.7% duplicate tokens removed for affected windows.
oncall-alice: rolling corrected counts into billing pipeline now (replay ingest). ETA 20m.
carol-sre: starting hotfix rollout: v2.1.5 emitter with corrected id format, canary 10% -> 100% if stable.
carol-sre: canary at 15:10 UTC, metrics look clean (no re-emits in canary). advancing to 50%.
ben-billing: outbound notification system resumed but blocked for accounts with adjusted corrections until final reconciliation completes.
dave-support: updated customers: "We've identified duplicate usage emissions leading to incorrect overage notifications. We're correcting counts and will reconcile charges. No action required on your side." Customers appreciated the clarity.
oncall-alice: reconciliation complete at 15:28 UTC. Adjusted counts applied; 3 customer notifications revoked (system-sent retract messages). Billing hold removed for unaffected accounts.
carol-sre: post-action items:
- revert v2.1.4 rollout record and ensure schema tests for event id in CI
- add rate-limited retry and id-stability check in emitter
- add alert that compares shadow-agg vs realtime with a 5% threshold and auto-pauses notifications
ben-billing: will document temporary credit process and notify finance for any adjustments.
oncall-alice: creating postmortem ticket INC-20251103-87 and linking runbooks, customer tickets, and timeline.
dave-support: closing support loop for acme-corp and beta-inc. smallstart requested final invoice; we'll send after finance reconciliation.
ben-billing: summary for execs: duplicate-emits from emitter v2.1.4 caused ~12-13% token inflation in EU, three customers received overage emails. Mitigations: paused billing notifications, dedupe backfill, hotfix v2.1.5, reconciled counts, issued customer outreach. No confirmed charge impact yet; finance to finalize credits.
oncall-alice: marking incident resolved in Slack at 15:45 UTC. Will follow up with full postmortem in 48h. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident state changed: RESOLVED by oncall-alice at 2025-11-03T15:45:02Z. Reference INC-20251103-87."
